verdict.rationale: Snyk is a proprietary SaaS security platform; only the CLI wrapper is on GitHub (snyk-gh-1..7) with no license text or claim of an open license provided in the evidence, and the core scanning engine, Snyk Code, DeepCode AI, and platform backend remain closed-source. No evidence pack item states an open-source license for any Snyk component, so the story is unmet. missing for 10: explicit open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) for the CLI repo, open-sourcing of core scanning/backend code, any statement of source availability for Snyk Code/DeepCode AI.
